retail_consumption.caveats: Contemporaneous descriptive association. Not an identified causal policy effect or validated 12-month forecast.

labor_market_transmission.classification: Illustrative Policy Assumption / Calibrated Sensitivity Rule

assumed_parameters.interpretation: +0.15pp unemployment per 100bps Fed Funds rate deviation above 2.5%

labor_market_transmission.rationale: Non-consecutive landmark years contain multi-year gaps (up to 5 years between 2010 and 2015) with only 11 consecutive 1-year pairs. Dynamic annual lag regressions cannot be defensibly identified without a continuous annual panel. Retained as an illustrative policy sensitivity heuristic.

inflation_persistence_drag.classification: Illustrative Policy Assumption / Calibrated AR-X Sensitivity

assumed_parameters.interpretation: Fraction 0.65 inflation persistence carried forward minus 0.08pp drag per 1pp Fed rate

inflation_persistence_drag.rationale: Multi-year gaps violate lag-1 dynamic assumptions. Retained as an illustrative simulation heuristic.

fit_diagnostic.diagnostic_title: Logistic MLE Separation Diagnostic on Landmark Snapshots
fit_diagnostic.conclusion: Standard logistic MLE diverges due to quasi-complete separation. The recession scoring formula is therefore retained purely as an illustrative heuristic stress index, NOT an empirically fitted or validated probability model.

methodological_distinctions.parameter_uncertainty: SE(beta) describes sampling standard deviation of coefficient estimators.
methodological_distinctions.conditional_mean_interval: mu_hat(x) +- t * s_e * sqrt(1/n + (x - x_bar)^2 / SS_xx). Uncertainty of the expected average response.
methodological_distinctions.forecast_prediction_interval: y_new +- t * s_e * sqrt(1 + 1/n + (x - x_bar)^2 / SS_xx). Substantially wider due to individual residual variance s_e^2.
methodological_distinctions.recession_scoring_classification: Illustrative macro stress scoring formula. With only 4 recession events in N=16 non-consecutive years, it is NOT an out-of-sample validated probability model.
methodological_distinctions.lag_structure_limitation: Multi-year gaps (up to 5 years between 2010 and 2015) violate uniform annual lag assumptions (t -> t+1). Continuous annual series is required for valid dynamic lag estimation.
